infrastructure.description: Infrastructure points contributed per YEAR, before the level multiplier and stacking weight. InfrastructureGrowthSystem accrues one twelfth of it each month and credits the reversible per-building ledger. Buildings are the only lane that can carry a province above passive_infrastructure_cap toward max_infrastructure.

missile_silo_capacity.description: Number of silo-based missiles (IRBM/ICBM) this building can host

mobile_launcher_capacity.description: Number of mobile TEL launcher units this building can support

slbm_loading.description: Whether this building enables SLBM loading onto submarine fleets at this port

missile_intercept_capacity.description: Number of incoming missiles this building can attempt to intercept per tick

missile_early_warning.description: Whether this building provides early warning radar, improving intercept chance

satellite_launch_capacity.description: Number of reconnaissance satellites this facility can build/keep in orbit for the owning country

export_multiplier.description: Fraction boost to this country's calibrated total export revenue (additive across all provinces)

import_discount.description: Fraction reduction in total import costs (additive across all provinces, capped at 25%)

tariff_reduction.description: Reduction to effective bilateral tariff rate applied in TradeSystem (additive)

production_role.description: Role of this building in the resource pipeline. Extraction unlocks latent resources; processing satisfies manufactured input chains; advanced raises ceilings on high-tech outputs; generic = pre-existing economic buildings.

unlocks_resource.description: Single resource this extraction building enables on a province (must also be in the province's latent resources). Use unlocks_resources for multi-target.

unlocks_resources.description: List of resources this extraction building can enable; each is gated by the province's latent resources.

specialty_resources.description: Resources this processing/advanced building satisfies in supply-chain input gating (replaces the 0.10 raw-extraction fallback).

consumes_inputs.description: Per-output-unit input draw applied by ResourceProductionSystem when this building runs.

recipes.description: Optional alternative input/output recipes for a processing/advanced building. When present and length > 1, the player may switch the active recipe per building instance via the Building Detail panel. When absent, the building runs a single implicit recipe synthesized from consumes_inputs + specialty_resources (legacy behaviour, no choice). Extraction buildings express their selectable outputs via unlocks_resources instead and do not use this field.

id.description: Stable recipe identifier (used for the localization key recipe.<id>).

inputs.description: Inputs consumed by this recipe (same shape as consumes_inputs).

geographic_requirement.description: Hard geography gate evaluated at construction-issue time.

tech_tier.description: UI hint for end-game tier (1=basic extraction/legacy, 2=processing, 3=advanced manufacturing).

max_level.description: Maximum upgrade level for this building (1 = no upgrades)

level_scaling_factor.description: Per-level additive multiplier: effect = base * (1 + (level-1) * factor)

upgrade_cost_factor.description: Multiplier applied to base construction cost when queuing an upgrade

upgrade_time_factor.description: Multiplier applied to base build_time_months when queuing an upgrade
